name: TD Timeout
description: -1 pt per TD for each timeout each team has remaining

name: Get Your Reps
description: Offensive players have their final score multiplied by their offensive snap %

name: Bird Law
description: +1 pt per reception for players on teams with a bird mascot (Cardinals, Falcons, Ravens, Seahawks, Eagles)
example: Player on Falcons team catches 3 passes -> +3 pts

name: Sack Attack
description: +10 pts per sack suffered by QB, -10 pts per sack for defense

name: Makin' Big Plays
description: x2, +10 pts for plays of 20 or more yards

name: Win or Go Home
description: x0 pts for players on a team that lost
example: Player's team lost -> final score x 0 = 0

name: Worst Ball
description: Starting slots are now filled with the lowest scoring players, this excludes scores of zero but not negative scores
example: Player 1: 10 pts, Player 2: 5 pts, Player 3: 0 pts -> Player 2 starts

name: Big Juicy Sacks
description: +1 pt per sack yard for defense
